mechanism_summary: The catalog Service's selector selects app=catalog-api while the catalog pods carry the label app=catalog, so the Service's Endpoints object stays empty and the gateway's connections to the service are refused even though the pods themselves are healthy.
decisive_evidence: Endpoints shop/catalog has no addresses while both catalog pods are Running and Ready; the Service spec shows selector app=catalog-api against pod labels app=catalog; the storefront-gateway logs show 'catalog fetch FAILED' against the service DNS name.
remediation_summary: Fix the catalog Service's selector to match the pod labels — kubectl -n shop patch service catalog -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"catalog"}}}' — Endpoints then populates with both pod IPs and the gateway's fetches succeed with no workload change.
